name: io.github.glitchless-gg/glitchless
title: Glitchless
description: Game observability for coding agents: stutters, crashes, custom metrics, dashboards, playtest bots

environmentVariables.name: GLITCHLESS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Glitchless server. Leave it unset after `npx glitchless-mcp login` (Glitchless Cloud); set it for a self-hosted server, such as http://localhost:7777

environmentVariables.name: GLITCHLESS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A workspace key (gl_ws_..., every game) or a game key (gl_sk_..., one game). Not needed after `npx glitchless-mcp login`

environmentVariables.name: GLITCHLESS_SERVICE
environmentVariables.description: The game to use when a tool call doesn't name one
